name: Yoru no Tobari
source:
This story follows Kuon, a student who is brought by his stepsister, Kano, to the remote Japanese village of Sarusawa. Kano is a freelance journalist who is running a story on the village's ancient customs, but the village leader, Etou, seems to be hiding something. As night descends, Kuon discovers exactly what kind of rituals the villagers have been so secretive about.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/267863/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕被义姐花乃带往日本偏远山村“猿泽村”的学生久音展开。身为自由记者的花乃此行是为了专题报道村里世代相传的古老风俗，然而村长江藤似乎隐瞒着什么秘密。随着夜幕降临，久音终于亲眼撞破了村民们讳莫如深的仪式究竟是何等真面目。

[摘自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/267863/]MobyGames[/url]]
